node.label: Fourth cranial nerve palsy
node.definition: Paralysis of the fourth cranial (trochlear) nerve manifested as weakness of the superior oblique muscle which causes vertical diplopia that is maximal when the affected eye is adducted and directed inferiorly.

evidence.snippet: Amoebiasis due to free-living amoebae: Fourth cranial nerve palsy (frequency HP:0040283) [TAS]
